Drive the organization toward ambitious flight test and certification milestones. Risk and Dependency Management: Proactively identify critical path risks, cross-team dependencies, and technical bottlenecks. Engineering and Manufacturing Coordination: Partner closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Flight Controls, Software, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams to ensure a seamless transition from prototype to flight test to production. Strong technical knowledge spanning hardware engineering, software development, systems engineering, and flight test operations. Proficiency with program management tools and methodologies, such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project, and Smartsheet. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and risk management skills, with a metrics-driven approach to tracking progress. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Systems) or Computer Science, or a related technical field. A resourceful, solutions-oriented mindset and the ability to build lean, effective processes in unstructured environments.
